answer: What survives to the anchor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The canyon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the kernel. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch, rewards vest against future work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
